mapper.sql: id, profile_id, created_by, visit_date, hospital_id, hospital_text, department, note, version, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO visit (profile_id, created_by, visit_date, hospital_id, hospital_text, department, note, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{profileId}, #{createdBy}, #{visitDate}, #{hospitalId}, #{hospitalText}, #{department}, #{note}, #{version}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM visit WHERE profile_id = #{profileId}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO visit_report (visit_id, report_id, created_at) VALUES (#{visitId}, #{reportId}, #{createdAt})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM visit_report WHERE visit_id = #{visitId} AND report_id = #{reportId}
mapper.select: SELECT vr.visit_id, r.id AS report_id, r.title, r.report_type, r.report_kind, r.examination_date, r.conclusion_text, r.processing_status FROM visit_report vr JOIN report r ON r.id = vr.report_id WHERE r.visibility_status = 'NORMAL' AND vr.visit_id IN #{vid} ORDER BY vr.visit_id, (r.examination_date IS NULL), r.examination_date DESC, r.id DESC

SELECT NULL AS visit_id, r.id AS report_id, r.title, r.report_type, r.report_kind, r.examination_date, r.conclusion_text, r.processing_status FROM report r WHERE r.profile_id = #{profileId} AND r.visibility_status = 'NORMAL' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM visit_report vr WHERE vr.report_id = r.id) ORDER BY (r.examination_date IS NULL), r.examination_date DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT v.id, v.profile_id, v.created_by, v.visit_date, v.hospital_id, v.hospital_text, v.department, v.note, v.version, v.created_at, v.updated_at FROM visit v JOIN visit_report vr ON vr.visit_id = v.id WHERE vr.report_id = #{reportId} ORDER BY v.visit_date DESC, v.id DESC
